key.system: You are listening to a short recording of a person speaking. Judge only the articulation of the words: are they slurred? Slow, breathless, hoarse, coughing, or tearful speech is not slurred unless the words themselves are blurred.

articulation.description: One sentence on how the words are articulated.

value: {"articulation": "Although the speaker sounds breathless and strained, all consonants and vowels are crisply and clearly articulated without blurring.", "slurred": "no"}
